lines.zh: 我浮在半空，肚皮朝下慢慢挪。
lines.en: I float midair, belly down, drifting along.

lines.zh: 我没有腿，只用整颗身子往前挤。
lines.en: I have no legs; my whole body pushes forward.

lines.zh: 我的嘴一张一合，往下一沉。
lines.en: My mouth opens and shuts as I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我漂过岩浆上方，热气托着我。
lines.en: I drift over the lava and the heat holds me up.
I shoulder a rock pillar aside.
I drift toward the opening ahead.
My fangs show on the outside.

lines.zh: 我上下起伏，像一颗浮着的球。
lines.en: I bob up and down like a floating ball.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过去，看了看来路。
lines.en: I turn slowly and look back the way I came.
I skim under the cavern roof.

lines.zh: 我朝有声音的方向挤过去。
lines.en: I push toward the noise.
I stop and hang there swaying.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，一只眼慢慢转。
lines.en: I hang still and my single eye rolls slowly.

lines.zh: 我的嘴半张着，牙露在外面。
lines.en: My mouth hangs half open with fangs showing.

lines.zh: 我一吐一吸，身体鼓起来。
lines.en: I swell and shrink with each breath.
The heat wraps me and feels good.
A lava bubble pops; I blink.
My tongue passes over my teeth.
I float, my belly rising and falling.
I draw my body in a little.

lines.zh: 我什么也不做，只是浮着。
lines.en: I do nothing; I only float.
Something crawls on the roof above.

lines.zh: 我把整颗身子转过来，一只眼对着你。
lines.en: I turn my whole body, one eye on you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，眼里有点发亮。
lines.en: I stare with a slight glow in my eye.
I have no other expression.

lines.zh: 你站得那么低，我得沉下来。
lines.en: You stand so low that I must sink to look.
I open my mouth and all my fangs show.
I float higher and look down on you.
I drift a little closer.
You retreat and I rise a little.

lines.zh: 这东西是活的，我要想想。
lines.en: This thing is alive; let me think.
My shadow falls over your head.
I roll over and steady myself in the air.

lines.zh: 我退开一截，眼还在看你。
lines.en: I back off and my eye stays on you.

lines.zh: 这一下让我在半空晃了晃。
lines.en: That leaves me swaying in the air.
I spit blood and my fangs are covered.
I open my mouth and roar.

lines.zh: 我往下沉了一点，才稳住。
lines.en: I sink a little before steadying.
That one goes on your tab.
My eye narrows.
I retreat behind a pillar.
That one had real weight.
I do not eat this kind.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我没兴趣。
lines.en: You hold it up and I lose interest.

lines.zh: 我只对动的东西感兴趣。
lines.en: Only moving things interest me.
I puff a breath at it.
I drift around it and move on.
Not enough to fill the gap in my teeth.
This thing doesn't suit my appetite.
I roll over and put it beneath me.
You will not draw me off with that.
I am not hungry.
You bounce off; I keep floating.

lines.zh: 我悬空着，你推就推着走。
lines.en: I am airborne, so a push carries me.
I turn and shove you off.

lines.zh: 我肚皮很软，撞上去不疼。
lines.en: My belly is soft; it does not hurt to hit.
I sink level with you.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我张嘴咬了个空。
lines.en: You knock me and I snap at nothing.
I draw back and float in again.
Keep away from me.
One hit spins me most of a turn.
I steady myself before looking at you.
I have nothing to do with that.
I am only a floating sphere.
I roll over, belly up.
I flick it aside.

lines.zh: 同族之间没有凑近的道理。
lines.en: My kind have no cause to draw near.
I drift toward the lava.
I shut my mouth.
I turn my back to it.
This territory fits only one.
I drift away.
I open my mouth and swallow.
Something's stuck between my teeth.
It dissolves in my mouth.
This is too hard.
I spit it out; it tastes bad.
I nudge it with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把它吞下，肚子鼓了一下。
lines.en: I swallow and my belly bulges once.
Too small — I swallow it whole.
I hold it in my mouth and grind slowly.
Useless; I spit it out.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的眼就定住了。
lines.en: You move and my eye locks on.
I stretch my mouth as far as it goes.
I sink slowly toward you.
There is blood in the air here.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你，别的都不看。
lines.en: I have you fixed and look nowhere else.
I begin to rise for an angle.
My fangs shift in my mouth.
You cannot run; you are in my range.
I look down at you.
One more move and I spit.
I have stopped over your head.

lines.zh: 你身上的热量，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see the heat of you.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，正对着它。
lines.en: I sink low and square up to it.

lines.zh: 它在那儿，我不打算放过。
lines.en: It is there, and I do not mean to let it go.

lines.zh: 我跟着你飘，始终在上面。
lines.en: I drift with you, always above.
You turn; my mouth follows.
I lower my height bit by bit.
I am finding an angle you cannot cover.
You raise a hand and I rise.

lines.zh: 你躲到柱子后面，我绕过去。
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar and I go around.
I stare at you, drooling.
The more you retreat, the lower I press.
I can see all of this area.
Raise your hand and I pounce.
Your panting is very clear.
A little closer and you are in range.
I hold directly above you.
I am not rushing; you must come out.
I can feel that you are about to move.
This one will not miss.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，牙刮过骨头。
lines.en: I bite down and my fangs scrape bone.
I slam my whole body into it.
I catch it and shake it.
Once bitten, don't expect me to let go.
It cuts me and I bite back.
I miss and my fangs clack.
I dip my head and bite again.
My mouth is full of its blood.
I push it against the wall.
I spit out the piece in my mouth.
I bite again and do not let go.
It retreats and I float higher.
That bite took a good deal.

lines.zh: 我慢慢退开，嘴上还挂着。
lines.en: I withdraw slowly, still hanging there.
One toss of my head knocks it off line.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的腿，往上一提。
lines.en: I bite its leg and haul it up.

lines.zh: 我从上方垂下来，肚皮先出现。
lines.en: I lower myself from above, belly first.

lines.zh: 我浮在洞口，一只眼往里看。
lines.en: I hover at the cave mouth, one eye peering in.
Lava light plays over me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转动，看了看四周。
lines.en: I turn slowly and survey the area.
My mouth hangs open with fangs out.
The heat holds me steady.
I drift a little deeper in.
This smell is familiar to me.
I let out a gurgle.
I circle half the cave mouth.
Something moves below.
I sink a little and see clearly.

lines.zh: 火对我没什么用，只是烤得我发干。
lines.en: Fire does little but dry me out.

lines.zh: 我从半空砸下去，肚皮先着地。
lines.en: I slam down from the air, belly first.
Water hits and I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 炸风把我掀翻，我滚了两圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I tumble twice.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的身子，我扭了一下。
lines.en: Something lodges in me and I twist.

lines.zh: 术式捏住我，我的眼一阵发黑。
lines.en: An art squeezes me and my eye goes black.

lines.zh: 太久没咬到东西，我发虚。
lines.en: Too long without biting anything leaves me weak.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我的身体，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning passes through me and I spasm.

lines.zh: 下头什么都没有，我一路坠下去。
lines.en: Nothing below and I fall away.
